title: Can DNA Predict Your Face? What Ancestry Results Can Tell
alt: Editorial illustration comparing visual face analysis with genetic ancestry research
description: Can DNA predict your face? Learn why ancestry percentages cannot reconstruct a selfie, what DNA phenotyping studies measure, and how to assess AI portraits.
deck: A chart of ancestry percentages is not a blueprint for a face. Genetic research, trait predictions and AI-generated portraits use different inputs—and deserve different expectations.

title: Ethnicity vs Nationality vs Ancestry: Differences Explained
alt: Editorial illustration about personal identity and family heritage
description: Understand ethnicity vs nationality vs ancestry with clear examples. Learn what DNA estimates and facial appearance can—and cannot—tell you about identity.
deck: Your family history, cultural identity and connection to a country can describe different parts of your life. A DNA percentage or a stranger’s guess does not have to settle all of them.

title: Is 1% Ancestry DNA Significant? Small Percentages Explained
alt: Illustration of a person reviewing an unexpected region in a DNA ancestry report
description: Is 1% ancestry DNA real or noise? Learn to check small ethnicity percentages, understand uncertainty and research family history without jumping to conclusions.
deck: A tiny unexpected region can raise a big question. Treat a 1% ancestry estimate as a lead to evaluate—not an automatic mistake or proof of a particular ancestor.
